Package index

English interface

Fully English functions with English parameter names. These are the recommended entry points for most users.

get_entities() get_entes()
Get list of Brazilian government entities
get_annexes() get_anexos()
Get report appendix reference table
get_annual_accounts()
Get annual accounts data (DCA) – English interface
get_delivery_status()
Get delivery status extract – English interface
get_budget_report()
Get Budget Execution Summary Report (RREO) – English interface
get_fiscal_report()
Get Fiscal Management Report (RGF) – English interface
get_msc_equity()
Get MSC equity/asset accounts – English interface
get_msc_budget()
Get MSC budgetary accounts – English interface
get_msc_control()
Get MSC control accounts – English interface

Portuguese interface (API-native)

Functions with Portuguese names matching the original API parameter names. Use these if you prefer to work directly with the API naming convention.

get_annexes() get_anexos()
Get report appendix reference table
get_entities() get_entes()
Get list of Brazilian government entities
get_dca()
Get annual accounts data (DCA)
get_extrato()
Get delivery status extract
get_rreo()
Get Budget Execution Summary Report data (RREO)
get_rgf()
Get Fiscal Management Report data (RGF)
get_msc_patrimonial()
Get MSC equity/asset accounts data
get_msc_orcamentaria()
Get MSC budgetary accounts data
get_msc_controle()
Get MSC control accounts data

Utilities

Helper functions

siconfir_clear_cache()
Clear the siconfir in-memory cache
